places.name: National Taichung Theater (Ito Toyo)
places.ai_summary: A modern architectural masterpiece designed by Ito Toyo, featuring unique curved walls and world-class performances.

opening_hours.notes: Performance schedules may vary.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for live performances and guided tours.
places.address: No.101, Huilai Rd, Xitun District, Taichung City, Taiwan

places.name: Rainbow Village
places.ai_summary: A vibrant and colorful village painted by a retired soldier, now a popular Instagram-worthy spot.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the vibrant murals.
places.address: No.56, Chun’an Rd, Nantun District, Taichung City, Taiwan

places.name: National Museum of Natural Science
places.ai_summary: A major natural history museum in Taichung, featuring extensive exhibits on science and nature.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the IMAX theater and the botanical garden.
places.address: No.1, Guanqian Rd, North District, Taichung City, Taiwan

places.name: Calligraphy Greenway
places.ai_summary: A scenic and artistic park area in Taichung, perfect for a leisurely stroll and enjoying outdoor art.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the various sculptures and art installations along the way.
places.address: No.100, Sec. 2, Shuangshi Rd, West District, Taichung City, Taiwan

places.name: Zhongshe Flower Market (Floral Garden)
places.ai_summary: A large flower market in Taichung, offering a wide variety of flowers and plants, as well as gardening supplies.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for fresh flowers.

places.place_tip: Explore the various themed gardens and flower fields.
places.address: No.168, Zhongzheng Rd, Qingshui District, Taichung City, Taiwan

places.name: Gaomei Wetlands Boardwalk
places.ai_summary: A scenic boardwalk in the Gaomei Wetlands, popular for birdwatching and enjoying sunsets.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during low tide for optimal viewing of tidal flats and wildlife.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for birdwatching and a camera for the stunning views.
places.address: No.1, Gaomei Village, Qingshui District, Taichung City, Taiwan

places.name: Fengjia Night Market
places.ai_summary: The largest night market in Taichung, famous for its wide variety of street food, shopping, and entertainment.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the full night market experience.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food and explore the various shops and stalls.
places.address: Fengjia Rd, Xitun District, Taichung City, Taiwan

places.name: Miyahara Ice Cream & Heritage Building
places.ai_summary: A famous ice cream shop in a beautifully restored heritage building, offering a wide variety of ice cream flavors and desserts.

opening_hours.notes: Popular flavors sell out quickly, best to visit early.

places.place_tip: Try the signature ice cream flavors and explore the heritage building.
places.address: No.20, Zhongshan Rd, Central District, Taichung City, Taiwan

places.name: Taichung Park & Lake Pavilion
places.ai_summary: A large public park in Taichung with a beautiful lake, walking paths, and a historic pavilion.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a leisurely walk around the lake and visit the historic pavilion.
places.address: No.37, Gongyuan Rd, North District, Taichung City, Taiwan

places.name: Houli Horse Ranch & Forest Park
places.ai_summary: A scenic area in Taichung with a horse ranch, forested trails, and picnic areas.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the cooler hours of the day.

places.place_tip: Enjoy horseback riding and explore the forest trails.
places.address: No.168, Zhongzheng Rd, Qingshui District, Taichung City, Taiwan

places.name: Sun Moon Lake Boat Tour
places.ai_summary: A scenic boat tour on Sun Moon Lake, offering stunning views of the lake and surrounding mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset for breathtaking views.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and enjoy the stunning scenery.
places.address: No.63, Zhongshan Rd, Yuchi Township, Nantou County, Taiwan

places.name: Wenwu Temple (Sun Moon Lake)
places.ai_summary: A famous temple near Sun Moon Lake, known for its beautiful architecture and serene surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Explore the temple grounds and enjoy the views of Sun Moon Lake.
places.address: No.63, Zhongshan Rd, Yuchi Township, Nantou County, Taiwan

places.name: Xiangshan Visitor Center (SML)
places.ai_summary: A visitor center at Sun Moon Lake, offering information, exhibits, and stunning views of the lake.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset for breathtaking views.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the panoramic views of Sun Moon Lake and the surrounding mountains.
places.address: No.63, Zhongshan Rd, Yuchi Township, Nantou County, Taiwan

places.name: Ci’en Pagoda (SML Viewpoint)
places.ai_summary: A pagoda located on a hill near Sun Moon Lake, offering panoramic views of the lake and mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset for breathtaking views.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top of the pagoda for the best views of Sun Moon Lake.
places.address: No.63, Zhongshan Rd, Yuchi Township, Nantou County, Taiwan

places.name: Shuishe Lakeside Trail (SML)
places.ai_summary: A scenic lakeside trail at Sun Moon Lake, perfect for walking, jogging, and enjoying the views.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a leisurely walk or bike ride along the lakeside trail.
places.address: No.63, Zhongshan Rd, Yuchi Township, Nantou County, Taiwan

places.name: Qingjing Farm (Nantou highlands)
places.ai_summary: A popular tourist destination in Nantou, known for its beautiful highland scenery, sheep grazing, and cool climate.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the fresh air, beautiful scenery, and sheep interactions.
places.address: No.170, Renhe Rd, Ren’ai Township, Nantou County, Taiwan

attribution.title: Wapiti from Wagon Trails
attribution.author: Brian0918
attribution.description: Appears to be an albino Elk, located at Wagon Trails Animal Park.

places.name: Hehuanshan Sunrise Point
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint in Nantou for watching the sunrise over the mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at least an hour before sunrise.

places.place_tip: Dress warmly and arrive early to secure a good viewing spot.
places.address: Hehuanshan, Ren’ai Township, Nantou County, Taiwan

places.name: Carton King Theme Spots (Taichung)
places.ai_summary: A unique theme park in Taichung made entirely of cardboard, featuring various attractions and activities.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the cooler hours of the day.

places.place_tip: Explore the various cardboard attractions and enjoy the creative displays.
places.address: No.10, Gongyuan Rd, North District, Taichung City, Taiwan

places.name: Guguan Hot Springs
places.ai_summary: A famous hot spring area in Taichung, known for its natural hot springs and beautiful mountain scenery.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the various hot spring baths and the beautiful mountain scenery.
places.address: No.168, Zhongzheng Rd, Qingshui District, Taichung City, Taiwan

places.name: Xitou Nature Education Area (Monster Village nearby)
places.ai_summary: A nature education area in Nantou, featuring walking trails, a suspension bridge, and a nearby village with monster-themed attractions.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the cooler hours of the day.

places.place_tip: Explore the walking trails and visit the nearby Monster Village.
places.address: No.1, Xitou Village, Lugu Township, Nantou County, Taiwan
